annotation.interpretation_a: The server could interpret 'current length' as the length of the selected representation at the time of the request.
annotation.interpretation_b: The server could interpret 'current length' as the length of the selected representation at the time of the response.
annotation.justification: The clause specifies that the Content-Range header should include the current length of the selected representation, but does not define when 'current' is measured. This missing constraint allows two materially different implementation behaviours: using the length at request time or at response time.
